Careers at NiCE

Make a difference.
Join our team.

At NiCE, we offer roles where you can really make an impact. Enjoy a high level of flexibility, with fully remote roles for customer-facing positions, and our hybrid NiCE-FLEX model for all other positions. The hybrid setup comprises 2-days in the office and 3-days of remote work per week, enabling the benefits of both worlds – working from home and collaborating in-person.
